text: A wall with a tooth missing. {lead} rebuilds it with no mortar and a great deal of dignity, and finds Sheep Wool in the hollow.
A cheese wheel stuck in a hollow, as they do. {lead} gives it a shove and down the slope it goes, and the hollow gives up Double Gloucester Round.
{lead} peers into the water, then pulls out, with great ceremony, some loose change and a gratitude card.
A wall with a tooth missing. {lead} rebuilds it with no mortar and a great deal of dignity, and finds a few coins in the hollow.
The wheel has been here since last spring's chase. {lead} sets it rolling, and underneath is a purse, a bit damp.
{lead} lofts the bowl clear over the hedge and the bale makes a fine step. You scramble over after it, picking out the odd twig.
You go back over the bale, and {lead} lofts the bowl after you. A passing cyclist nods, as if this is normal.
Soft ground, a patient creature, and a lot of worms. {lead} brings up the lot, and under them: Wild Garlic.
